Method of Attack: Pulls in every single npm package as dependencies causing massive transitive dependency resolution
Prevents authors from unpublishing their packages due to npm policy on dependencies
Causes potential storage exhaustion and system slowdown by downloading millions of packages
Discoverer: Jossef Harush, Head of Software Supply Chain Security at Checkmarx
Attack Vector: npm package installation via 'npm install everything' command
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of 'everything' package and its 3000+ sub-packages on npmjs.com
Long dependency chains preventing unpublishing of packages
